consumption.en: Researchers estimated household consumption using repeated survey data collected across several regions.
consumption.zh: 研究人员利用多地收集的重复调查数据估计了家庭消费水平。

consumption.en: The agency reduced its own consumption of paper by requiring digital reporting throughout the department.
consumption.zh: 该机构通过要求全部门使用数字化报告，减少了自身的纸张消耗。

consumption.en: Rising consumption of imported grain placed considerable pressure on the domestic agricultural sector.
consumption.zh: 进口谷物消费量的上升给国内农业部门带来了相当大的压力。

cooperation.en: The findings suggest that cooperation between disciplines produces more robust conclusions than isolated effort.
cooperation.zh: 研究结果表明，跨学科合作比各自孤立努力更能得出稳健的结论。

cooperation.en: Regional authorities extended cooperation to share monitoring data during the outbreak investigation.
cooperation.zh: 地方当局在疫情调查期间扩大合作范围，共享监测数据。

cooperation.en: Such cooperation depends on clear institutional incentives and sustained funding across the participating agencies.
cooperation.zh: 此类合作取决于清晰的制度激励以及参与机构之间持续的经费支持。

controversy.en: The methodology has generated considerable controversy among practitioners of the discipline.
controversy.zh: 这一方法在该领域的从业者中引起了相当大的争议。

controversy.en: The controversy was settled only after the raw data were released for independent scrutiny.
controversy.zh: 只有在原始数据被公开以供独立审查之后，这场争议才得以平息。

controversy.en: Political controversy surrounding the regulation delayed its implementation for several months.
controversy.zh: 围绕该法规的政治争议使其推迟实施数月。

density.en: Population density explains only part of the variation observed across the sampled districts.
density.zh: 人口密度只能解释各抽样地区之间所观察到差异的一部分。

density.en: Regulators required developers to limit housing density near existing transport infrastructure.
density.zh: 监管机构要求开发商限制现有交通基础设施附近的住房密度。

density.en: Higher tree density reduced surface temperatures along the urban streets during the summer months.
density.zh: 更高的树木密度降低了夏季城市街道的地表温度。

depth.en: Interview depth improved the validity of the qualitative analysis considerably.
depth.zh: 访谈深度显著提升了定性分析的效度。

depth.en: The study examines the depth of cooperation between public agencies and local communities.
depth.zh: 该研究考察了公共机构与地方社区合作深入的程度。

depth.en: Hydrographic surveys recorded the depth of the channel along its entire navigable reach.
depth.zh: 水文测量记录了航道可通航河段沿线的深度。

detection.en: Earlier detection of the disease substantially improved the survival rate of treated patients.
detection.zh: 更早的疾病检出显著提高了接受治疗患者的存活率。

detection.en: Regulations require the detection of hazardous materials before construction begins in the area.
detection.zh: 法规要求在该地区施工开始前检出危险材料。

detection.en: The method allows rapid detection of small concentrations of contaminants in drinking water.
detection.zh: 该方法能够快速检出饮用水中微量的污染物。

duration.en: The duration of the interview was limited to prevent fatigue among older participants.
duration.zh: 访谈的持续时间受到限制，以防年长参与者产生疲劳。

duration.en: Attention must be paid to the duration of each treatment phase in the clinical protocol.
duration.zh: 必须关注临床方案中每个治疗阶段的持续时间。

duration.en: A longer duration of follow-up would have strengthened the evidence for the causal claim.
duration.zh: 更长的随访持续时间本可加强支持因果主张的证据。

ecology.en: Wetland ecology provides breeding habitat for numerous migratory bird species.
ecology.zh: 湿地生态为众多候鸟物种提供了繁殖栖息地。

ecology.en: The policy seeks to restore the ecology of rivers degraded by decades of industrial discharge.
ecology.zh: 该政策旨在恢复因数十年工业排放而退化的河流生态。

ecology.en: Ecological knowledge held by local farmers remains valuable for understanding regional ecology.
ecology.zh: 当地农民所掌握的生态知识对于理解区域生态仍然具有价值。

epidemiology.en: Modern epidemiology relies on longitudinal cohorts to identify causal relationships between exposure and disease.
epidemiology.zh: 现代流行病学依赖纵向队列来识别暴露与疾病之间的因果关系。

epidemiology.en: The department of epidemiology coordinates surveillance across regional hospitals and clinics.
epidemiology.zh: 流行病学部门协调各地区医院与诊所的监测工作。

epidemiology.en: Developments in molecular epidemiology reshaped the understanding of the outbreak's transmission pattern.
epidemiology.zh: 分子流行病学的发展重塑了对该疫情传播模式的理解。

equilibrium.en: The model assumes that the system quickly returns to equilibrium after a small disturbance.
equilibrium.zh: 该模型假定系统在小扰动之后会迅速回到均衡状态。

equilibrium.en: Fiscal rules are designed to maintain equilibrium between revenue and public expenditure over the cycle.
equilibrium.zh: 财政规则旨在维持整个经济周期内收入与公共支出之间的均衡。

equilibrium.en: Ecological equilibrium was disrupted when the invasive species spread throughout the river basin.
equilibrium.zh: 当入侵物种蔓延至整个流域时，生态平衡被打破。

equivalence.en: The study tests the equivalence of two measurement instruments across different populations.
equivalence.zh: 该研究检验了两种测量工具在不同人群中的等效性。

equivalence.en: Legal scholars dispute the equivalence of commercial arbitration and ordinary litigation.
equivalence.zh: 法学学者对商事仲裁与普通诉讼的等同性存在争议。

equivalence.en: No empirical basis establishes the equivalence of these two competing theoretical accounts.
equivalence.zh: 并无经验基础能够确立这两种相互竞争的理论解释之间的对等性。

essence.en: The essence of the argument lies in its treatment of historical context.
essence.zh: 该论证的实质在于其对历史语境的处理。

essence.en: Participants were asked to identify the essence of the problem before proposing solutions.
essence.zh: 参与者被要求在提出解决方案之前厘清问题的本质。

essence.en: Understanding the essence of this debate requires careful reading of the original correspondence.
essence.zh: 理解这场争论的精髓需要仔细阅读原始往来信件。

exclusion.en: Exclusion criteria were applied before enrollment to ensure a homogeneous analytical sample.
exclusion.zh: 在入组前设定排除标准，以确保分析样本的同质性。

exclusion.en: Social exclusion of migrants remains a serious concern for urban policy planners.
exclusion.zh: 移民遭受社会排斥仍是城市政策规划者所关切的重要问题。

exclusion.en: The exclusion of unusable records slightly reduced the statistical power of the analysis.
exclusion.zh: 剔除不可用记录略微降低了该分析的统计效力。

expectation.en: Participants' expectations about the purpose of the study were recorded before data collection began.
expectation.zh: 参与者对该研究目的的预期在数据收集开始之前即被记录下来。

expectation.en: Current evidence falls short of the expectation that the treatment will prove broadly effective.
expectation.zh: 现有证据未能达到该治疗将被证明普遍有效这一预期。

expectation.en: Contrary to widespread expectation, the reform produced no measurable change in regional inequality.
expectation.zh: 与普遍预期相反，该改革未对地区不平等产生可测量的变化。
